lines.text: Keep your Dear ImGui code. Upgrade every pixel to studio grade.
Meet ImKit 4.2. Apply one theme, and your existing widget calls gain refined geometry, OKLCH depth, and fluid motion, with zero rewrite.
Same values, side by side. A completely modern finish, while keeping every native contract intact.
New in 4.2: a four-layer customization engine across twenty-two rebuilt widgets, from theme files and typed scopes to custom skins.
Fourteen built-in worlds powered by OKLCH surface zones. Recolor your entire workspace in a single call.
Dial in corners, outlines, and shadows live in Theme Studio, or switch back to the Classic preset anytime.
Build complete creative workspaces out of the box, with role-colored dock bands, floating panels, hierarchies, and structured inspectors.
On the multi-track timeline, new filmstrip clip thumbnails and zoom-locked canvas backdrops keep heavy video editing crystal clear.
A readable node editor with typed wire colors, pin glyphs, and instant connection feedback, while your app keeps the graph state.
Interactive telemetry charts and capability-aware PTZ controls fit right in.
Built for live production, and ready for AI-driven workflows.
The Show module brings cue launchers, tactile control surfaces, and LED wall tile maps together under one unified design language.
Highlight automated or AI-agent control clearly with DrawGlowFrame and ExternalControlIndicator, signaling every phase at a glance.
Keep long tasks legible with StepBand, WaitCard, and expandable toast details.
Plus 321 crisp icons and the standalone imkit::motion keyframe engine.
Integration takes minutes. Three lines in CMake, three lines in C++, and you link only the targets your application actually needs.
Zero lock-in. Your Dear ImGui context, your renderer, your fonts, and your undo history stay one hundred percent owned by your app.
Ship creative tools that look as sharp as they perform. Download the native Gallery and SDK for Windows and macOS today.
ImKit 4.2. MIT licensed, C++20 ready. Build your next tool.
